title: Syringol isolated from Eleusine coracana (L.) Gaertn bran suppresses inflammatory response through the down-regulation of cPLA(2), COX-2, IkappaBalpha, p38 and MPO signaling in sPLA(2) induced mice paw oedema.
authors: Milan Gowda, M D; Jayachandra, K; Joshi, Vikram; Manjuprasanna, Vaddarahally N; Rudresha, Gotravalli V; Velmurugan, Devadasan; Pachaiappan, Raman; Jameel, Noor Mohamed; Vishwanath, Bannikuppe S
one_liner_zh: 该文研究植物来源丁香酚的抗炎作用，涉及sPLA2酶抑制与分子对接，但对象为蛋白-小分子而非蛋白质-DNA互作，无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Eleusine coracana (L.) Gaertn (E. coracana) is one of the highest consuming food crops in Asia and Africa. E. coracana is a plant with several medicinal values including anti-ulcerative, anti-diabetic, anti-viral and anti-cancer properties. However, the anti-inflammatory property of E. coracana remains to be elucidated. Therefore, the objective of present study was to investigate the potential in isolated molecule from E. coracana via a combination of in vitro, in vivo and in silico methods. In this study, we have isolated, purified and characterized an anti-inflammatory molecule from E. coracana bran extract known as syringol. Purification of syringol was accomplished by combination of GC-MS and RP-HPLC techniques. Syringol significantly inhibited the enzymes activity of sPLA(2) (IC(50) = 3.00 microg) and 5-LOX (IC(50) = 0.325 microg) in vitro. The inhibition is independent of substrate concentration, calcium ion concentration and was irreversible. Syringol interacts with purified sPLA(2) enzymes as evidenced by fluorescence and molecular docking studies. Further, the syringol molecule dose dependently inhibited the development of sPLA(2) and lambda-carrageenan induced edema. Furthermore, syringol decreases the expression of cPLA(2), COX-2, IkappaBalpha, p38 and MPO in edematous tissues as demonstrated by western blots. These studies revealed that syringol isolated from E. coracana bran may develop as a potent anti-inflammatory molecule.
abstract_zh: Eleusine coracana (L.) Gaertn（E. coracana）是亚洲和非洲消费量最高的粮食作物之一。E. coracana 是一种具有多种药用价值的植物，包括抗溃疡、抗糖尿病、抗病毒和抗癌特性。然而，E. coracana 的抗炎特性仍有待阐明。因此，本研究的目标是通过体外、体内和计算机模拟方法的组合，探究从 E. coracana 中分离的分子潜力。在本研究中，我们从 E. coracana 麸皮提取物中分离、纯化并表征了一种抗炎分子，称为丁香酚 (syringol)。丁香酚的纯化通过 GC-MS 和 RP-HPLC 技术的组合完成。丁香酚在体外显著抑制 sPLA(2)（IC(50) = 3.00 微克）和 5-LOX（IC(50) = 0.325 微克）的酶活性。该抑制作用不依赖于底物浓度和钙离子浓度，且是不可逆的。荧光和分子对接研究证明，丁香酚与纯化的 sPLA(2) 酶相互作用。此外，丁香酚分子剂量依赖性地抑制了 sPLA(2) 和 λ-卡拉胶诱导的水肿发展。进一步地，蛋白质印迹分析显示，丁香酚降低了水肿组织中 cPLA(2)、COX-2、IkappaBalpha、p38 和 MPO 的表达。这些研究表明，从 E. coracana 麸皮中分离的丁香酚可能开发为一种有效的抗炎分子。
